MiroFish Report Agent conversation
format_version: 1
Scope: All displayed stored turns in the current Report Agent conversation from this browser page session. Displayed error notices may appear as assistant messages.
This is not a complete run history, historical graph snapshot, verified model trace or resumable conversation.
Content is stored message text, including Markdown syntax, not rendered HTML. Hidden prompts and tool metadata are excluded.
Encoding: UTF-8 with fixed English labels. String values use two-space indentation and preserve ordinary Unicode, spaces and every LF. Backslashes, CR, tab, other controls and lone surrogates use visible escapes.
Escapes describe individual values; TXT is not an import format. Indentation and the final LF are presentation syntax.
